code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    R,C=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=set()
    for r in range(R):
      for c in range(C):
       if g[r][c]!=5 or (r,c) in seen: continue
       stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
       while stack:
        y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
        for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
         q=(y+dy,x+dx)
         if 0<=q[0]<R and 0<=q[1]<C and g[q[0]][q[1]]==5 and q not in seen: seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
       rs=[y for y,x in comp]; cs=[x for y,x in comp]
       top,bottom,left,right=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
       # fill rectangular cavity
       for y in range(top+1,bottom):
        for x in range(left+1,right):
         if g[y][x]==0: g[y][x]=2
       # project from the single missing top-edge cell outward horizontally
       gaps=[x for x in range(left,right+1) if g[top][x]!=5]
       if len(gaps)==1:
        x=gaps[0]
        direction=-1 if x-left>right-x else 1
        x2=x
        while 0<=x2<C:
         g[top-1][x2]=2
         x2+=direction
    return g
'''
